study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Mao et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping early corpus callosum development to identify neurodevelopmental risk

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dataset 1 (295 TDC) and Dataset 2 (41 TDC; 26 ASD) collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital; two scanners (1.5 T Siemens; 3 T Philips)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study utilized two brain imaging datasets collected at Zhejiang Children ' s Hospital, Zhejiang University. Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC), aged 1 -6 years... Dataset 2 includes brain images from 26 children with ASD and 41 TDC children."

answer.Dataset 2 (TDC+ASD): independent validation/generalizability testing and classifier evaluation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Dataset 1 used to construct sex-specific growth curve models; Dataset 2 used to assess model generalizability on a different scanner and classify ASD vs TDC using deviation scores
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC), aged 1 -6 years, and was used to construct growth curve models of the corpus callosum. Dataset 2 includes brain images from 26 children with ASD and 41 TDC children. Dataset 2 was used to assess the capability of the growth curve models to identify ASD based on deviations in corpus callosum morphology."
